topic: My toddler keeps stalling at bedtime: one more drink, one more story, one more hug
video_title: One more drink at bedtime? What to say instead (ages 2-5)
caption:
One more drink. One more story. One more hug.

Stalling at lights-out is a common sleep problem at ages 1-6.
Take care of needs like a drink or the bathroom before the routine ends.
Then ask once: anything else before lights out? Meet one simple request.
Keep it calm, kind and the same every night.
